notes.note: Brad Hill had 31 disposals at 87% and is looking a good replacement for the injured Nas. He has had some good scores of late including four over 110 in the last six.
Hill continued his good form with another 28 disposals. A solid option for us late in the season.
On the back of two big games Hill was a popular pick  this week but had just the 24 disposals at 75% in the loss to the Cats.
